title: Post-Wildfire Restoration in the 2018 Camp Fire Area
description: A produced video documents post-wildfire restoration efforts within the 2018 Camp Fire footprint on the Plumas National Forest, Feb. 11, 2026. The production features interviews with forestry professionals and partners detailing multi-year projects designed to restore forest health and improve landscape resilience following the wildfire. (Forest Service video by Andrew Avitt)
